rows.title: Cellpose: a generalist algorithm for cellular segmentation
rows.method: Cellpose, a generalist deep learning segmentation model (2D model reused for 3D extension without 3D-labeled data)
rows.modality: Light microscopy (cells, membranes, nuclei; 2D and 3D image types)
rows.dataset: New Cellpose training dataset of highly varied cell images (>70,000 segmented objects)
rows.summary: Introduces Cellpose, a generalist deep learning segmentation method trained on a diverse dataset of >70,000 objects that segments cells across many image types without retraining or parameter adjustment and outperforms established methods on 2D and 3D datasets.

rows.title: A deep learning-based algorithm for 2-D cell segmentation in microscopy images.
rows.method: Deep learning prediction of cell and nucleus locations combined with thresholding and watershed segmentation
rows.modality: Single-channel fluorescence light microscopy of cell cultures (whole-cell markers, various magnifications)
rows.dataset: private cohort (different sets of cell-culture images stained with various markers at different magnifications)
rows.summary: Presents a single-channel whole-cell segmentation algorithm that uses deep learning to locate cells and nuclei followed by thresholding and watershed, achieving 86% similarity to ground truth across varied markers and magnifications.

rows.title: Scellseg: A style-aware deep learning tool for adaptive cell instance segmentation by contrastive fine-tuning.
rows.method: Scellseg: style-aware pre-trained deep learning model with contrastive fine-tuning (also uses unlabeled data) for cell instance segmentation
rows.modality: Microscopy images at organelle, cell and organism levels
rows.dataset: not stated (disparate microscopy datasets at three biological levels)
rows.metric_values: not stated (state-of-the-art transferability in average precision and Aggregated Jaccard Index; performance plateaus after ~8 fine-tuning images)
rows.summary: Proposes Scellseg, an adaptive pipeline combining a style-aware pre-trained model with contrastive fine-tuning that achieves state-of-the-art transferability across organelle-, cell- and organism-level datasets with only ~8 annotated images, delivered with a GUI.

rows.title: DetecDiv, a generalist deep-learning platform for automated cell division tracking and survival analysis.
rows.method: DetecDiv: deep learning platform combining time-series classification and image semantic segmentation for cell division tracking
rows.modality: Time-lapse microscopy of yeast in microfluidic traps
rows.dataset: private cohort (microfluidic time-lapse yeast imaging across various imaging platforms and trap geometries)
rows.summary: Develops DetecDiv, a microfluidic image acquisition and deep learning platform that automatically reconstructs single-cell replicative lifespans in yeast with high accuracy and quantifies cell cycle, stress-response and survival dynamics.

rows.title: DeepSCEM: A User-Friendly Solution for Deep Learning-Based Image Segmentation in Cellular Electron Microscopy.
rows.method: DeepSCEM: user-friendly convolutional neural network tool for organelle segmentation
rows.summary: Presents DeepSCEM, an easy-to-use tool for fast and efficient deep learning segmentation of cellular electron micrographs with a focus on user-friendly generation and training of organelle segmentation models.

rows.title: Artificial Intelligence for Organelle Segmentation in Live-Cell Imaging.
rows.method: Review of segmentation algorithms from thresholding to deep learning (including label-efficient, synthetic-data and physics-guided strategies)
rows.summary: Reviews recent advances in live-cell organelle segmentation algorithms, discusses challenges in 3D, multi-organelle and cross-modality generalization, and highlights label-efficient strategies toward generalist models.

rows.title: Leveraging multimodal microscopy to optimize deep learning models for cell segmentation.
rows.method: Deep learning cell segmentation models trained on subimage stacks sampled from hyper-labeled multichannel image stacks to compare labeling strategies
rows.modality: Multimodal high-throughput microscopy (fluorescence markers and label-free/brightfield, including out-of-focus brightfield)
rows.dataset: not stated (hyper-labeled image stacks of identical cells)
rows.summary: Uses subimage stacks drawn from hyper-labeled microscopy stacks to directly compare fluorescence and label-free training strategies on identical cells, finding fluorescence generally more accurate but label-free more robust to inconsistent labeling, and that combining channels improves generality.

rows.title: Cellpose as a reliable method for single-cell segmentation of autofluorescence microscopy images.
rows.method: Cellpose deep learning network with a newly trained autofluorescence-trained model (ATM) for nuclear segmentation
rows.modality: Autofluorescence multiphoton intensity microscopy of NAD(P)H with co-registered FLIM of NAD(P)H and FAD
rows.dataset: private cohort (PANC-1 cells treated with metabolic inhibitors and patient-derived cancer organoids from 9 patients)
rows.metric_values: Dice between repeated ATM masks significantly higher than repeated manual masks (p < 0.0001); R² > 0.9 between ATM and manual masks for ORR, mean NAD(P)H lifetime and mean FAD lifetime
rows.summary: Validates a Cellpose autofluorescence-trained model for single-cell nuclear segmentation of NAD(P)H images, showing higher reproducibility than manual segmentation and high correlation of FLIM and redox metrics in 2D and 3D cultures.

rows.title: Automatic improvement of deep learning-based cell segmentation in time-lapse microscopy by neural architecture search.
rows.method: Neural architecture search (NAS) jointly searching non-repeatable micro architectures with a live-cell-specific search space including convolutional LSTM
rows.dataset: 2D datasets from the Cell Tracking Challenge (ten datasets)
rows.metric_values: not stated (more consistent top performance across all ten datasets than other challenge methods)
rows.summary: Proposes a NAS-based method that automatically designs cell segmentation networks for time-lapse microscopy, incorporating ConvLSTM for temporal information, and achieves consistently top performance across all ten 2D Cell Tracking Challenge datasets.

rows.title: Instance segmentation of mitochondria in electron microscopy images with a generalist deep learning model trained on a diverse dataset
rows.method: MitoNet, a generalist deep learning instance segmentation model trained on a diverse dataset; released via the empanada Python package and napari plugin
rows.dataset: Newly amassed heterogeneous ~1.5 × 10^6 image 2D unlabeled cellular EM dataset with ~135,000 segmented mitochondrial instances
rows.summary: Builds a highly heterogeneous cellular EM dataset with ~135,000 segmented mitochondria and trains MitoNet, a generalist model that performs well on challenging benchmarks and unseen volume EM datasets, released with the empanada inference and proofreading tools.
